# Notice

FrigateHub is a native Android client for user-configured Frigate NVR servers.

This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the Frigate project or its maintainers. Frigate is the name of the NVR software that this app connects to.

## Third-Party Components

FrigateHub depends on open source Android and Kotlin libraries, including:

- Android Gradle Plugin
- Kotlin
- AndroidX Core, AppCompat, Activity, ConstraintLayout, Navigation, Palette, SwipeRefreshLayout, and Media3
- Material Components for Android
- Firebase Cloud Messaging
- OkHttp
- NiceHttp
- Glide and Glide OkHttp integration
- Glide Transformations
- Jackson Kotlin module
- Kotlinx Serialization JSON
- Eclipse Paho MQTT client
- SnakeYAML
- Facebook Shimmer
- Google FlexboxLayout
- JUnit, AndroidX Test, and Espresso

Each third-party component is distributed under its own license. Review dependency metadata and upstream project license files before redistributing release builds.

## Media And Trademarks

Camera snapshots, live streams, clips, exports, face images, and other media shown by FrigateHub come from the Frigate server configured by the user. Users are responsible for complying with applicable laws and policies for the cameras, media, and notification destinations they configure.

Android, Google Play, Firebase, and other product names may be trademarks of their respective owners.
